data.one_liner: Integrate GitHub's Octicons easily in your Flutter project.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to use GitHub's Octicons as Flutter widgets. Automatically updates itself nightly to stay in sync with the upstream Octicons project.
use_when: You need GitHub iconography in your Flutter application
You want automatic nightly updates to stay in sync with the latest upstream icon additions
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose icon set like FontAwesome or Material icons instead of GitHub-specific icons
You need icons with strict version pinning that won't change upstream
strengths: Automatically stays up-to-date with upstream Octicons via nightly automation
Simple and straightforward usage similar to standard Flutter icons
weaknesses: New minor versions may contain breaking changes if icons are modified or deleted upstream

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need the massive FontAwesome icon set instead of GitHub's Octicons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Lucide icons for your Flutter app.
